svg.text: owner Conolas · C + RISC-V assembly · rv32imc_zicsr · stored in rom_dp, uses ram_sp for data and stack
Configures and supervises the hardware through the register banks. Never in the real-time loop.
WHAT THE PROGRAM DOES (jobs, in order)
timer_isr (mcause 7, vector 0x1C): write 1 to TMR STATUS.IRQ_PENDING, set heartbeat flag
external_isr (mcause 11, vector 0x2C): read SAFE FAULT_STATUS, set fault flag, mask the interrupt in mie
exc_handler (offset 0x00): save mcause / mepc / mtval, set FAIL code, stop
volatile 32-bit register access · time-out on every wait · interrupt handlers never read-modify-write peripheral registers · no printf, no floating point at run time
ARM last; the hardware decides whether arming is allowed; after a fault the CPU never re-arms by itself.
